projects.title: Herdr Lanes
projects.summary: Fan-out orchestration for cloud coding sessions: one feature scope per lane, disjoint files, merged through a review gate.
highlights: Spawns and attaches isolated lanes from a single ops tab
Worktree-per-lane layout removed cross-session index collisions
Review gate keeps every lane ready to merge

projects.title: Trail Log
projects.summary: Offline-first hiking journal that syncs GPX tracks, photos and notes once you are back in signal range.
highlights: Conflict-free sync for edits made on two devices offline
Track simplification cut stored GPX size by about 80%
Battery-aware location sampling

projects.title: Doc Diff
projects.summary: Semantic diff for Markdown that highlights moved sections and reworded paragraphs, not just changed lines.
highlights: Detects section moves across a whole document tree
Diffing runs in a worker so large docs never block typing

projects.title: Ledger Lite
projects.summary: Plain-text budgeting CLI with monthly rollups, category rules and CSV import from common bank exports.
highlights: Rule engine auto-categorizes about 90% of imported transactions
Imports from five bank CSV dialects

projects.title: Pixel Garden
projects.summary: Generative art toy: plant seeds on a grid and watch L-system plants grow, wilt and cross-pollinate.
highlights: Deterministic seeds so gardens can be shared as URLs
Holds 60 fps with 2,000 plants on a mid-range phone

projects.title: Quiet Hours
projects.summary: Desktop focus timer that mutes notifications, logs sessions and shows a weekly heatmap of deep work.
highlights: Native do-not-disturb integration on three platforms

projects.title: Shelf Scan
projects.summary: Point a phone at a bookshelf to catalogue every spine, then search your library by title, author or colour.
highlights: On-device OCR, so no photos leave the phone
Batch mode catalogues a full shelf in one pass

projects.title: Deploy Radar
projects.summary: Dashboard that correlates deploys with error-rate and latency changes so regressions surface within minutes.
highlights: Change-point detection flags a regression within 5 minutes
Adopted by three internal teams

projects.title: Type Pairs
projects.summary: Font-pairing explorer that previews heading and body combinations on real layouts with contrast checks.
highlights: Flags pairings that fail WCAG contrast at body sizes
Exports CSS custom properties

projects.title: Commit Coach
projects.summary: Git hook that reviews a staged diff and suggests a focused commit message, or a split when the change is doing two things.
highlights: Suggests splitting commits that mix refactors with features
Runs offline with a local model, or with an API key

projects.title: Tide Tables
projects.summary: Lightweight tide and swell forecast site for small harbours, built to load fast on patchy coastal connections.
highlights: Under 30 KB on first load
Last forecast stays readable offline

projects.title: Kiln
projects.summary: Reproducible dev environments from one declarative file, with cached layers shared across a team.
highlights: Cut cold environment setup from 20 minutes to under 2
Maintains the layer-cache subsystem

projects.title: Sign Sketch
projects.summary: Practice tool for learning fingerspelling, with hand-pose feedback from the webcam in real time.
highlights: Runs fully in the browser; video is never uploaded

projects.title: Budget Board
projects.summary: Shared household budget board with envelopes, recurring bills and a monthly what-changed digest.
highlights: Monthly digest email explained every change in plain language

projects.title: Lanternlight
projects.summary: Game-jam puzzle game where your lantern reveals only part of a shifting maze. Built in 48 hours.
highlights: Placed top 10% for innovation in a 48-hour jam

projects.title: Logline
projects.summary: Terminal log viewer that tails several services at once with structured filtering and colour-coded sources.
highlights: Filters JSON logs by field without a pre-built index
Keeps memory flat while tailing millions of lines
